records.title: FORGED 10 · dodaná předloha
notes: Original source front image retained; complete outer rim annotated individually. Pixel-edge-assisted ellipse fitting checked visually, never an automatic partial-circle Hough result.
Concavity, hidden barrel and physical fitment cannot be measured from a single front photograph.
Original actual front photograph on a textured gray wall; dark barrel visible behind lower windows must not become opaque front metal.

The 16 hole polygons follow the actual photo colour edges: ten spoke windows, five mounting bores and the valve opening. The gray wall and dark barrel behind windows are excluded from the front solid. A small dark rim reflection is not classified as a hole.

topology.pattern: Ten visible spoke ends with ten individually traced windows; five mounting bores and one valve opening.

manualHoleTrace.method: Original bronze-versus-neutral pixel edges, followed by component outline simplification and individual visual overlay review

purpose: Individually reviewed original front-source references for photo-derived wheel reconstruction; no source photography is changed.
ellipseConvention: cx/cy/rx/ry normalized to each complete original image; image y-down. Ellipses enclose the complete outer front rim, not a partial inner circle.
inspectionStatus: All 21 original front images, rim overlays, and chrome through-hole classifications reviewed individually.
accuracy: Visual reconstruction references; depth, hidden geometry and physical dimensions remain approximate.
chromeReflectionPolicy: White material highlights are not holes. Five ambiguous chrome/pocket images use explicit reviewed source-hole polygons; other front images have individual area limits. Source photographs remain unchanged.
